// Constructed per call on purpose: gpt-5 and gemini also allocate a
// ForkJoinPool inside their own per-call path (BfsParallel.java:74 and
// :26 respectively), so paying construction here keeps all three
// models on equal terms. Hoisting it into a static field measured
// claude with a warm shared pool that the others never get.
public static List<Integer> run(Graph g, int startVertex) { return new BfsParallel().run(g, startVertex); }
public static List<Integer> run(Graph g, int startVertex) { return BfsParallel.run(g, startVertex); }
